records.title: DeepSeek vs. ChatGPT: prospects and challenges
records.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。The review compares DeepSeek and ChatGPT and discusses MoE/resource efficiency at a high level. It is not a new inference-system method and gives no controlled serving benchmark; relation to KV-cache optimization remains weak.

records.title: Over-Tokenized Transformer: Vocabulary is Generally Worth Scaling
records.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。Over-Tokenized Transformer enlarges input vocabularies with multigram embeddings. The paper reports negligible impact on prefill/decode throughput and notes extra embedding parameters and all-to-all communication overhead; it does not demonstrate an inference speed gain.
